title: Design System: dmytro klochko — dream / bebop

display.purpose: Section titles: clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 3.9rem). Mono caps, -0.035em, in bebop.

dream-display-hero.purpose: The name on /: Zodiak 600 italic lowercase, clamp(3.4rem, 7vw, 6rem).

dream-display.purpose: Dream section titles: Zodiak 600 italic lowercase, clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.9rem), -0.015em.

dream-lede.purpose: One serif italic opener per section: clamp(1.45rem, 2vw, 1.65rem).

dream-fact.purpose: Hero fact values (--t-fact): 1.22rem serif, a step above prose and below the lede — the elaya label/value grid.

dream-prose.purpose: Newsreader running copy: 1.13rem / 1.66. One compensating step up because serif reads smaller than mono at equal rem.

lede.purpose: Bebop's one large paragraph per section: t-lg, -0.02em.

body.purpose: Running mono copy: t-md 0.98rem, -0.012em, line-height 1.72, measure min(100%, 62ch).

label.purpose: t-xs 0.75rem mono caps at 0.18em tracking: nav, labels, captions, machinery in both modes.

shadows.name: mat-portrait
shadows.purpose: The portrait in its 8px cream mat; deepens to 0 14px 34px rgb(10 10 26 / 55%) on hover.

shadows.name: peek-print
shadows.purpose: Peek prints above the cursor in dream (bebop uses 0 10px 30px rgb(0 0 0 / 55%)).

shadows.name: caption-dusk
shadows.purpose: Portrait caption's breath of dusk where it lands on open water, outside the darkest glass.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Every transition; dur 200ms, dur-slow 320ms for lifts and mats.

motion.name: scene-crossfade
motion.purpose: Fixed scene layers swap when a section claims the sky (IntersectionObserver, −42% centred band).

motion.name: scene-breathe
motion.purpose: The painting breathes; imperceptible per-frame, alive per-minute.

motion.name: scene-parallax
motion.purpose: Compositor-only drift against scroll and eased cursor; skipped for reduced motion and coarse pointers.

motion.name: sun-pulse
motion.purpose: The painted sun warms and cools on the swim scene only — light over the art, never new art.

motion.name: glint-drift
motion.purpose: Four light glints on the water; swim and estuary scenes.

motion.name: petal-fall
motion.purpose: Six petals, always, in front of everything; l-i-s-a adds sixteen one-shot petals at 2.4–5s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Kills petals, weather, parallax, scene transitions, and autoplaying video.

breakpoints.name: glass-full
breakpoints.purpose: Smoked glass steps to brightness(0.5); the hang goes full-width.

breakpoints.name: small
breakpoints.purpose: Grids step down; dream portrait caps at min(70%, 300px).

smokedGlass.value: backdrop-filter: brightness(0.48) saturate(0.92) over rgb(24 28 46 / 24%), fixed, full-viewport
smokedGlass.fallback: left-weighted dusk gradient where backdrop-filter is unsupported
smokedGlass.purpose: Dims the painting itself under cream text; light scenes darken enough, dark scenes barely change. Never opaque paint over the art.

sceneMap.rule: One painting per URL; every future page claims one of its own. Idle preload of other scenes runs only in dream.
sceneMap.dormant: Ember and snow weather CSS gates on data-scene fire/snow, which no shipped page names — plumbing, not current behaviour.

components.name: Mode Toggle
components.description: Text-only toggle between dream and bebop; persists to localStorage before paint, swaps theme-color.
components.css: .ds-mode-toggle { padding: 0.3rem 0; border: 0; background: none; color: #a9aecb; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-mode-toggle:hover, .ds-mode-toggle:focus-visible { color: #ff9bc0; }

components.name: Nav Link (dream, current page)
components.description: Mono caps nav; the current page is held in pink parentheses in dream (brackets in bebop).
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.4rem; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #262b44; padding: 1rem; } .ds-nav a { color: #ece6d9; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #ff9bc0; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-current { color: #a9aecb; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-current::before { content: '('; color: rgb(255 155 192 / 60%); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-current::after { content: ')'; color: rgb(255 155 192 / 60%); }

components.name: Matted Print
components.description: The dream photograph treatment: cream mat, slight tilt, hover straightens and lifts 3px while the shadow deepens.
components.css: .ds-mat { margin: 1.5rem; width: 280px; } .ds-mat img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border: 8px solid #fbf3e2; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgb(10 10 26 / 45%); transform: rotate(1.2deg); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-mat:hover img { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgb(10 10 26 / 55%); } .ds-mat figcaption { margin-top: 0.5rem; color: #a9aecb; font-family: 'Newsreader', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: lowercase; }

components.name: Pink Italic Accent
components.description: Inline emphasis in dream prose: pink italic, no painted underlay. Replaced the marker swash 2026-08-13.
components.html: the site is his own paintings, full-bleed, and the text visits them.
components.css: .ds-swash-demo { max-width: 34ch; padding: 1rem; background: #262b44; color: #ece6d9; font-family: 'Newsreader', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.13rem; line-height: 1.66; } .ds-swash-demo b { font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; color: #ff9bc0; background: none; }

components.name: Dream Section Title
components.description: A real heading in the display voice: Zodiak 600 italic, lowercase, no section number in dream.
components.css: .ds-dream-title { margin: 0; padding: 1rem; background: #262b44; color: #ece6d9; font-family: 'Zodiak', 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.4vw, 2.9rem); letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-transform: none; }

narrative.northStar: Two skies over one markup: a terminal in deep space (bebop, default) and his own paintings full-bleed behind smoked glass (dream, behind the toggle).
narrative.overview: The site ships two complete art directions over the same HTML, switched by data-mode on the root, chosen before first paint. Dream inherits bebop's layout wholesale — the 78rem shell, the 6fr/5fr bays, the 62ch measure, every grid — and only reskins what sits on them: one of his 4K paintings per URL as a fixed, breathing, parallaxing scene, read through full-viewport smoked glass. Serif speaks sentences (Newsreader 1.13rem/1.66, Zodiak 600 italic for display); mono keeps the machinery. Pink is his favourite colour and the only accent.
keyCharacteristics: one painting per URL, full-bleed, breathing
smoked glass readability — dim the art, never paint over it
cream mats, tilts that straighten on hover, falling petals

rules.name: The Sampled/Derived Sky Rule
rules.body: Every colour traces to his paintings; all art is his or a professional's. Nothing figurative is invented here — five rejections carved this in stone.

rules.name: The Subject Owns The Wing Rule
rules.body: Text placement follows the paintings' composition, not habit: the column sits wherever the artwork's subject is not.

rules.name: The Glass Never Paints Rule
rules.body: Readability comes from dimming the art through smoked glass, never from panels, veils, or colour laid on top.

rules.name: The Arrow Is Inline Rule
rules.body: .arw is plain inline with a relative-offset hover hop, never inline-block: an inline-block creates a break opportunity after itself even with no whitespace.

rules.name: The Peek Rule
rules.body: Words naming something real may lift a small stack of photographs above the cursor. Hover-and-fine-pointer only, so phones see plain text, never a half-working version.

dos: Do derive every colour and every piece of art from his paintings, photographs, or a professional's work.
Do give serif one compensating size step over mono (1.13rem prose).
Do answer hover with a lift that settles: straighten, −3px, deeper shadow.
Do keep every standalone link ≥24px tall.
donts: Don't write copy nobody asked for. Every invented caption on this site has been cut, usually angrily.
Don't hand-draw figurative art (ASCII or icons). Derived, sampled, or made by professionals — four rejections earned this rule.
Don't reach for a hairline to separate things.
Don't let art blur or pixelate: contained sizes or high-res sources only.
Don't fix readability with cream/white panels — dim the painting itself.

northStar: Two skies over one markup: his own paintings full-bleed behind smoked glass (dream, default) and a terminal in deep space (bebop, behind the toggle).
